appContext.category: Patient visit and communication journey library
appContext.summary: Chapter 2 in a comprehensive native feature library, beyond the initial ten slides. Capture Marcus/metabolic Demo. Show selected appointment → practical readiness → patient observations → real optional AI questions → reviewed brief → communication. Use supplied mint/blush/butter/forest and existing real-screen-plus-short-caption style. No live EHR, booking or provider receipt claims; don't fabricate unavailable screens.

theme.style: Soft clinical-paper world built from mint, blush, butter and deep forest: calm matte gradients that feel like warm printed paper rather than glossy tech. Light is diffused and daylight-soft from the upper left, with gentle grain, subtle paper fiber texture and rounded organic shapes. Backgrounds stay quiet and airy so the real app screens and short captions carry the meaning — reassuring, human, never clinical-cold or robotic.
